resolved_findings.problem: --init-groups differs from the original CM01 parent --clear-groups and may add service authority. Root identity validation checks Uid/capabilities but not Gid/Groups.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: Preserve clear-groups and verify all Gid fields plus the empty supplementary group set.

resolved_findings.problem: Frame reads/responses lack the shared deadline. Already-frozen census can accept after expiry; JS caches a receipt after retention without a final stop/deadline/settled check. The launcher grants communicate another120s after its startup poll.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: Use one absolute start+120 deadline throughout waits/frames/census; use remaining time for communicate. Check before and after final retention/receipt I/O and before a positive continuation decision.

resolved_findings.problem: Cached per-client receipts bypass current checks; equivalent_native_settled depends on receipt presence and may remain true after later work. Prior receipts prove historical retirement, not current global closure.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: Retain historical receipts but require fresh global pending/coverage/queue checks and a final correlated scope census for current closure. A queued/in-process task cannot be discharged by cgroup census alone.

resolved_findings.problem: Scope startup and controller construction precede any enclosing cleanup finally. Errors there can leave actor processes; killpg(systemd-run) alone does not establish entire scope termination.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: An encompassing finally must thaw and stop/reap only the exact owned scope on failure, including constructor/registration errors. Preserve errors/remaining processes, never report success from forced cleanup.

resolved_findings.problem: Receipt scope identity is only a path hash; the registration uses current census identities without explicit launcher generation/root-bound expected peer.
resolved_findings.minimum_correction: Bind scope UUID plus filesystem dev/inode and exact root-recorded Node peer/parent PID+starttime before native execution; enforce that identity at each census and response.

correction_anchors.owned_cleanup: Controller75-103 finally thaws and stops only the exact owned unit, uses bounded cleanup/reaping and exact owned cgroup kill if needed; cleanup errors and leftovers remain explicit.

ordinary_confirmation.condition: Run only after the negative check establishes that expected rejection and clean owned-scope closure, with no unrelated error/timeout/leftover substituted as success.
ordinary_confirmation.upstream: Existing public mocked transport only; zero external inference and original inputs.
